card.name: Linking words in computing references
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" and "to", or "the" and "13th", inside citations of computer science papers and in descriptions of software or security books. Most often after "Proceedings".

modes.label: Proceedings citations
modes.description: The word "of", "the" or an ordinal after "Proceedings" in a conference citation.
modes.example: Understanding Data Lifetime via Whole System Simulation, Proceedings<< of>> the 13th USENIX

modes.label: Linking words in software text
modes.description: "of" or "to" in descriptions of free software freedoms, database books or security work.
modes.example: The freedom<< to>> redistribute copies so you can help your neighbor
